info.name: GTFS API — Transit + Ferry + Rail
info.description:
FastAPI backend in `api.py` serving **three separate databases** from one service: transit (bus), ferry (water) and rail.

Every endpoint keeps its original path and takes `?mode=transit|ferry|rail` (default: transit).

**Build the databases**
```
python3 gtfs_builder.py        # builds gtfs.sqlite + water-gtfs.sqlite + rail-gtfs.sqlite
```

**Run the server**
```
python3 -m uvicorn api:app --reload --port 8000
```

**Agency filtering** — `/api/routes` and `/api/gtfs-stops` accept `agency_id`; see folder 04.

**Variables** — `baseUrl`, `mode`, `osmNodeId`.
Sample IDs are unprefixed and mode-specific.

**Tips** — percent-encode `+` as `%2B` in `departure_date_time`, and percent-encode rail route IDs (`/`, `+`, `=`).
